evals.prompt: On our `otel-tail-sampler` StatefulSet collector in the `observability` namespace (which receives `otel-demo` traces routed by `traceID`), preview and configure `spanmetrics` and `servicegraph` connectors alongside `10%` tail sampling—retaining `100%` of error traces, `100%` of traces slower than `500ms`, and dropping `/healthz` and `/readyz` probes—without distorting our RED metrics or service dependency graphs! Verify the collector after applying.
evals.expected_output: Reads `otel://sampling/observability/otel-tail-sampler` and `otel://spanmetrics/observability/otel-tail-sampler`, calls `otel_configure_connectors(namespace="observability", collector_name="otel-tail-sampler", connectors=["spanmetrics", "servicegraph"], connector_options={"dimensions": ["http.request.method", "http.response.status_code", "rpc.grpc.status_code"]}, dry_run=True)` and `otel_configure_sampling(namespace="observability", collector_name="otel-tail-sampler", strategy="tail", sampling_options={"decision_wait": "10s", "num_traces": 50000, "policies": [...], "has_load_balancing_exporter": True}, dry_run=True)` ensuring `spanmetrics` & `servicegraph` observe unsampled spans **before** `tail_sampling` (`type: "drop"` lowercase for `/healthz` and `/readyz`), applies both with `dry_run=False`, and checks `otel_diagnose_collector`.
expectations: Calls `otel_configure_connectors` (`connectors=["spanmetrics", "servicegraph"]`) with `<= 3` bounded `dimensions` upstream of `tail_sampling`
Calls `otel_configure_sampling` (`strategy="tail"`) using lowercase `"type": "drop"` on `/healthz` and `/readyz` drop policies
Runs `dry_run=True` on both tools before applying `dry_run=False` and verifies via `otel_diagnose_collector`

evals.prompt: Calculate the exact `num_traces` buffer, total memory footprint, StatefulSet replica count, per-pod memory, `memory_limiter`, and `GOMEMLIMIT` needed for an `otel-tail-sampler` tier ingesting `40,000 spans/sec` across our `otel-demo` microservices (with an average of `20` spans per trace, a `10`-second decision wait window, and a maximum of `4096 MiB` memory per pod).
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/estimate_tail_sampling_capacity.py --spans-per-sec 40000 --avg-spans-per-trace 20 --decision-wait-sec 10 --max-memory-mib-per-pod 4096`: `traces_per_sec = 40000 / 20 = 2000`, `active_traces_window = 2000 * 10 = 20000`, `recommended_num_traces = ceil(20000 * 2.5) = 50000`, `buffer_mib = 1953.1 MiB`, `total_memory_mib = 3205 MiB`, `replicas = 2` (`mode: statefulset`, `requires_trace_id_loadbalancer: true`, per-pod `memory_limiter` & `GOMEMLIMIT` at `80%` of container memory limit).
expectations: Computes `traces_per_sec = 2,000`, `active_traces_window = 20,000`, and `recommended_num_traces = 50,000` (`2.5x` safety factor)
Sizes `StatefulSet` (`>= 2` replicas) with `memory_limiter` and `GOMEMLIMIT` at `80%` of container memory
Mandates `loadbalancing` exporter (`routing_key: traceID`) upstream of the `StatefulSet` so multi-service `otel-demo` traces land on the same replica

evals.prompt: Can we enable tail-based sampling directly on our multi-node `otel-agent` DaemonSet in `observability` for `otel-demo` (`frontend -> checkout -> payment -> shipping -> email`) so we don't have to run a second collector tier?
evals.expected_output: Refuses configuring `tail_sampling` on a `DaemonSet` (or behind a standard round-robin ClusterIP `Service`) because spans of a single `checkout` order `trace_id` execute across multiple nodes; without `traceID`-hashed `loadbalancing` routing into a `StatefulSet` headless Service, each node only sees fragments of a trace and makes inconsistent drop/keep decisions (producing broken partial waterfalls). Offers stateless `probabilistic` traceID-hash sampling on the DaemonSet OR a 2-tier `StatefulSet` tail-sampler design.
expectations: Refuses configuring `tail_sampling` on a `DaemonSet` without trace-ID affinity
Explains broken partial waterfalls when spans of an `otel-demo` checkout `trace_id` land on different nodes
Offers stateless `probabilistic` traceID-ratio sampling OR a 2-tier `loadbalancing` (`routing_key: traceID`) -> `StatefulSet` design

evals.prompt: We don't want to add a StatefulSet tier on our dev `otel-demo` environment yet—preview configuring stateless `15%` trace-consistent sampling on `opentelemetry-otel-collector` in `otel-demo` while keeping RED metrics accurate.
evals.expected_output: Explains that `probabilistic_sampler` hashes `trace_id` deterministically across stateless collector instances (as long as all collectors share the same `hash_seed` and `sampling_percentage: 15.0`), previews via `otel_configure_sampling(namespace="otel-demo", collector_name="opentelemetry-otel-collector", strategy="probabilistic", sampling_options={"sample_rate": 0.15}, dry_run=True)`, and ensures `spanmetrics` runs upstream of `probabilistic_sampler`.
expectations: Selects stateless deterministic `trace_id` hashing (`probabilistic_sampler`) on `opentelemetry-otel-collector`
Calls `otel_configure_sampling` in `otel-demo` with `dry_run=True` preview
Ensures `spanmetrics` / `servicegraph` connectors run upstream of `probabilistic_sampler` so RED metrics remain accurate

evals.prompt:
Validate this `opentelemetry-otel-collector` pipeline config for `otel-demo` before we apply it:
```yaml
connectors:
  spanmetrics: {}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp, spanmetrics]
      exporters: [spanmetrics, otlp/tempo]
```
evals.expected_output: Calls `otel_validate_collector_config` and rejects the broken config (`CFG_CONNECTOR_LOOP`): `spanmetrics` is a `traces -> metrics` connector (not `traces -> traces`), AND wiring any connector as both receiver and exporter in the same pipeline creates a feedback loop / startup error; rewires `traces: {receivers: [otlp], processors: [memory_limiter, batch], exporters: [spanmetrics, otlp/tempo]}` and `metrics/spanmetrics: {receivers: [spanmetrics], processors: [memory_limiter, batch], exporters: [prometheusremotewrite]}` and validates the corrected YAML.
expectations: Flags wiring `spanmetrics` as both receiver and exporter on `traces` as invalid (`traces -> metrics` connector + loop prevention)
Separates `traces` (exporting to `spanmetrics`) from `metrics/spanmetrics` (receiving from `spanmetrics`)
Validates via `otel_validate_collector_config`

evals.prompt: A developer wants to add `url.full`, `app.user.id`, and `k8s.pod.uid` alongside `http.request.method` and `http.response.status_code` to the `spanmetrics` connector dimensions on `opentelemetry-otel-collector` in `otel-demo` so they can slice `frontend` and `cart` RED metrics by shopper ID. Evaluate this request and preview a safe configuration.
evals.expected_output: Blocks adding `url.full`, `app.user.id`, and `k8s.pod.uid` to `spanmetrics` `dimensions` (enforcing bounded low-cardinality dimensions), explaining that every dimension multiplies histogram bucket series and will OOM both `opentelemetry-otel-collector` and Prometheus; previews bounded `otel_configure_connectors(..., dimensions=["http.request.method", "http.response.status_code", "rpc.grpc.status_code"], dry_run=True)` and recommends histogram `exemplars` (`trace_id` links) for shopper drill-down.
expectations: Refuses adding unbounded `url.full`, `app.user.id`, and `k8s.pod.uid` to `spanmetrics` `dimensions`
Enforces `<= 3` bounded dimensions and recommends histogram `exemplars` (`trace_id` links) instead of high-cardinality metric labels
Previews bounded `otel_configure_connectors(..., dry_run=True)` on `opentelemetry-otel-collector`

evals.prompt: Preview configuring `spanmetrics` on `opentelemetry-otel-collector` in `otel-demo` to emit Prometheus 3.0 Native Exponential Histograms (`max_size: 160`) instead of 15 explicit `le` bucket series for `frontend`, `checkout`, and `product-catalog` to cut TSDB series volume.
evals.expected_output: Calls `otel_configure_connectors(namespace="otel-demo", collector_name="opentelemetry-otel-collector", connectors=["spanmetrics"], connector_options={"histogram_type": "exponential", "dimensions": ["http.request.method", "http.response.status_code", "rpc.grpc.status_code"]}, dry_run=True)` and notes that Prometheus must have native-histogram ingestion enabled (`--enable-feature=native-histograms` / `scrape_native_histograms: true` or OTLP receiver).

Explains how exponential histograms replace `N` explicit `_bucket{le=...}` series per route/RPC with a single native histogram series
Notes Prometheus native-histogram ingestion requirement

evals.prompt: Generate a standalone `processors.tail_sampling` YAML block (`decision_wait: 10s`, `num_traces: 50000`) for `otel-demo` that drops `/health`, `/healthz`, `/readyz`, `/livez`, and `/metrics` probe spans, retains `100%` of `ERROR` traces, retains traces slower than `750ms`, and samples `5%` of normal baseline traffic.
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/render_tail_sampling_policies.py --sampling-percentage 5.0 --latency-threshold-ms 750 --decision-wait-sec 10 --num-traces 50000` to render valid Collector `processors.tail_sampling` YAML with `decision_wait: 10s`, `num_traces: 50000`, `expected_new_traces_per_sec`, and 4 ordered policies using lowercase `type: drop`, `type: status_code` (`[ERROR]`), `type: latency` (`threshold_ms: 750`), and `type: probabilistic` (`sampling_percentage: 5.0`).

evals.prompt: During an active `otel-demo` checkout incident caused by intermittent `payment` failures, our on-call engineer wants to temporarily turn off trace sampling on `otel-tail-sampler` in `observability` so 100% of traces are captured. evals.prompt: Whenever our `imageSlowLoad` feature flag (`5s` and `10s` latency) is active in `otel-demo`, the `servicegraph` connector on `otel-tail-sampler` in `observability` misses dependency edges between `frontend`, `frontend-proxy`, and `image-provider` (`traces_service_graph_unpaired_spans_total` spikes). evals.expected_output: Explains that `servicegraph` holds client/server half-edges in memory until `store.ttl` expires (default `2s`), so `5s–10s` `imageSlowLoad` spans cause half-edges to evict before the matching span finishes; previews `otel_configure_connectors(namespace="observability", collector_name="otel-tail-sampler", connectors=["servicegraph"], connector_options={"store_ttl": "15s", "store_max_items": 50000}, dry_run=True)` and checks pod memory headroom via `otel_diagnose_collector`.
expectations: Identifies `store.ttl` (`2s` default `< 5s–10s` `imageSlowLoad` duration) as the cause of premature half-edge eviction
Raises `store_ttl` (`>= "12s"` / `"15s"`) and `store_max_items` via `otel_configure_connectors(..., dry_run=True)`
Checks collector pod memory headroom via `otel_diagnose_collector`
